newsitem.title: CANADA: Mitel shares rise after earnings.
newsitem.headline: Mitel shares rise after earnings.

text.p: Shares in Mitel Corp rose in brisk trade on Thursday the day after the company posted better than expected second-quarter earnings.
Mitel's second-quarter net income rose to C$16.5 million or C$0.14 a share diluted from C$15.0 million or C$0.13 a share in the prior year period.

"They were about one cent better on the operating end than what I was looking for," said Mark Lawrence, an analyst at Loewen Ondaatje McCutcheon. He said the market welcomed the sequential order growth in Mitel's private branch exchange switch business from the first quarter to the second.
"The other thing of course was that semiconductor sales were very strong on a year-over-year basis, although sequentially they were down a little bit," Lawrence added.
Mitel shares were up 0.45 to 9.05 in Toronto on more than two million shares. They hit a peak of 9.25 earlier.
